en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an interior religious object, likely inside a church or chapel. At the center stands a tall stone or wooden pedestal supporting a polygonal pulpit or reading desk decorated with relief carvings of saints or biblical figures in niches or window-like frames. The wall behind is tiled stone; to the left hangs a small reliquary or liturgical apparatus and to the right is a lectern or book box mounted on the wall. The lower wall paneling is carved with floral or heraldic motifs. There is faint writing or marks near the top edge of the image.
